text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Symptoms of overdose may include hypersensitivity reactions such as systemic allergic reactions or severe local allergic reactions [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )] . In case of severe adverse reactions such as angioedema, difficulty in swallowing, difficulty in breathing, changes in voice, or feeling of fullness in the throat, immediate medical evaluation is needed. These reactions should be treated as medically indicated, including the use of epinephrine as appropriate [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )] .
